title: Tailwise Autoship Shipment Milestones on Pals Rewards Missed-Earning Postings
content:
A subscription milestone rate is added to the **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** missed-earning rate, in points per qualifying dollar, according to the shipment's position in its Tailwise Autoship subscription — the shipment sequence number shown on the Tailwise Autoship shipment charge.

| Shipment sequence number in its subscription | Milestone rate added |
|---|---|
| 12 or higher | 1.0 |
| 6 to 11 | 0.5 |
| 1 to 5 | none |

**Edges of each band (hypothetical shipments).** The 5th shipment of a subscription adds nothing; the 6th adds 0.5; the 11th adds 0.5; the 12th and every later one add 1.0.

**Which number counts.** The sequence number of the shipment whose earning is being posted, within its own subscription. A customer with several Tailwise Autoship subscriptions does not combine their counts for this rate: a 4th shipment of one subscription stays below 6 even if another subscription has reached its 20th.
